note: Where every 'must' feature of reference/features.json lives. 'theme' = built in theme/ (file named), 'split' = theme part built, rest owned by the named piece, 'deferred' = owned by the named later piece. Generated 2026-10-17 by the theme-foundation builder.

templates/customers/*.why: The theme targets Shopify's new customer accounts: header, menu drawer and footer link to routes.account_url, and Shopify hosts login, register, orders and addresses. The current vendored Dawn and Horizon ship no templates/customers/* either. Classic customer accounts are legacy; a store that still uses them gets Shopify's fallback pages.
templates/customers/*.owner: piece 6 docs: docs must tell the owner to switch Settings > Customer accounts to the new customer accounts (and that classic accounts would need customers/* templates).
